# AniStream v2.2.4

Bugs & improvements: more players that work on the first click, full screen that just works, and a
calmer look.

## Improvements

- ⚡️ A new main anime player, with **Switch player** on anime pages to change it any time. Your
  Sub/Dub choice is kept for the title, and AniStream tells you when a dub isn't available
- ⚡️ Two more Movies & TV players, so more titles find one that plays
- ⚡️ If a player starts the wrong show or movie, AniStream notices and moves to the next one
- ⚡️ Full screen opens instantly from any player's own button and stays there
- ⚡️ Keyboard controls work in every player, including the main anime player
- ⚡️ Anime title pages show sharp, full-size backdrops instead of stretched banners
- ⚡️ "Did you mean" now catches one-word typos, like "Narto" or "Frierne"
- 💄 A calmer look: colour only where it matters, a new Schedule with day tabs, a "Playing next"
  card in Up Next, a tidier Settings and Search start page, and a new launch screen

## Bug fixes

- 🦺 Full screen in embedded players lagged, then dropped back to a window
- 🦺 A player's blocked pop-up could swallow your first click
- 🦺 Some movie and show players played the wrong One Piece (live action vs anime)
- 🦺 Search's top result could show stray HTML in its description

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.2.4-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.2.4.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream downloads this update in the background and installs it when you choose
**Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session
are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Check a download against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or confirm it was built by this
project's release workflow with
`gh attestation verify AniStream.Setup.2.2.4.exe --repo Athen2045/AniStream`.
